author: StewieFG
body:
Hey guys! :D

I have been making a map for the tournament, I hope you'll like it.

Info: The map is a bit small for the normal Nebula matches, and that's because scrims have less players than a regular Nebula match. It's a gameplay wised map, and I hope it'll play good. Also it has aesthetics, not to less, and not too much, I hope you'll like it!

Name: Dried Desert

Creators: ElectraXdroid

Gamemode: Capture The Wool

Images: http://imgur.com/a/yubhD

Download: Coming soon.

YAML: Coming soon.

Feedback is always appreciated :)

replies.author: Vobaseball12
replies.body:
Here's some feedback after taking a look at the pictures.

-Get rid of the little floating island on the way to the wool room, makes it easier for people to get in, and since this is a tm map, it's supposed to be harder, and a team effort to get into the wool room. If you were to make a public edition, I would keep that island.

-I would consider changing the wool gear from boots to pants, and putting a power 1, punch 1 bow in the wool gear chest.

replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
The layout is nothing that special so there shouldn't be any bigger issues with gameplay.

Since this is a tournament map I think that resources are very important and the amount of iron should be lower. It will make teams have to worry about wasting their iron which will be a big factor in tournament play.

The lanes are really thin. You need to make them wider. Thin lanes will make it too easy to just knock a player off and it will make defences very OP as there is such a small amount of blocks that have to be removed.

The palette is ok when you just look at the main island but the wool rooms (with the wood), the stairs (cobble stairs) and the sides of the islands (clay) it just looks like its random blocks you threw together. Stick to one theme which in this case would be the sandstone one.

Everything is very very flat. There is no height differences on the map which in a tournament map, is even more important.

I will go to wool room gear now. It is too OP. Adding diamond swords and armor (boots) is not a good idea. IMO you should just leave them have iron swords but have an enchantment on them. I would recommend having knockback but with the thin lanes that would just be horrible. Adding sharpness will make it be better than a diamond sword so that would be a no too. Just look at some possible enchantments or maybe give them power bows.

As for the spawn kit I think you should just start by giving them stone swords and have them craft iron swords. 

It would also be nice if you could round up the corners. It would just make the map look a tad nicer.

A lot of potential in this map but IMO it would need a lot of work (making lanes wider etc.) to have it as a decent tournament map.

replies.author: FrozenSolstice
replies.body:
I really don't have much experience with tournament maps, since I've never been involved in a tournament. Overall, though, the map seems like it'd play well.
As mentioned before, more structures and terrain would really make it pop.
Also, just a little tweak that I think would be cool, maybe add a oasis-type thing around the middle island, it gives contrast to all the warm colours, adds to the desert theme, and would add a unique style of gameplay.
Great job do far though!
